sections.content: Use *porque* to explain why an action has happened. The reason can follow a sentence in the *pretérito* *perfecto*: He *vuelto* porque ha *llovido*. The verb after porque is conjugated normally.

items.english: I have returned because it has rained.

items.spanish: Hemos cambiado la ruta porque ha llovido.
items.english: We have changed the route because it has rained.
I have rested because I am tired.

items.spanish: Hemos decidido volver porque ha llovido.
items.english: We have decided to return because it has rained.

sections.content: Use *porque* to answer 'why?' and por *eso* to show a consequence.
